date_inferred_from: Entered on leaf 78 verso directly above the heading of the sitting of 16 August 1775; the heading of its own sitting is on an earlier page, not among the scans. The office sat every few days, so the entry is placed in the same month.
text:
Extractus Commissionis ad Bona Trąpczyn designat[o?] Oblata
Videatur hoc Loco Extractus Sancitae Constitutionis in Ordine demandatae ad Fundum Bonorum Trąmpczyn fine Dislimitationis Bonorum Eorundem cum Bonis Łukom a Statibus Reipublicae Commissionis et Actis Curiae Regiae Varsavie~ deprompti Oblata in Productis.

translation.en:
Extract of the Commission Assigned to the Estate of Trąbczyn — Oblata

Let there be seen here the Extract of the enacted Constitution, ordered in respect of the estate of the goods of Trąbczyn for the purpose of the re-delimitation of the same goods with the goods of Łukom by the Estates of the Republic — drawn from the Acts of the Commission and of the Royal Court of Warsaw — enrolled among the Produced Documents.

text_english:
Extract of the Commission Assigned to the Estate of Trąbczyn — Oblata

Let there be seen here the Extract of the enacted Constitution, ordered in respect of the estate of the goods of Trąbczyn for the purpose of the re-delimitation of the same goods with the goods of Łukom by the Estates of the Republic — drawn from the Acts of the Commission and of the Royal Court of Warsaw — enrolled among the Produced Documents.
summary_en: A register note in the book of the castle court at Konin, August 1775: an extract is brought in of the constitution by which the Estates of the Republic ordered a commission to the ground of Trąbczyn, to mark that estate off from Łukom; the extract was drawn from the records of the royal court at Warsaw and is among the documents produced.
summary_de: Registervermerk im Buch des Burggerichts Konin, August 1775: Vorgelegt wird ein Auszug der Konstitution, mit der die Stände der Republik eine Kommission auf den Grund von Trąbczyn angeordnet haben, um dieses Gut gegen Łukom abzugrenzen; der Auszug ist den Akten des königlichen Hofes in Warschau entnommen und liegt bei den vorgelegten Schriftstücken.
